name: binohash
title: Binohash optimisation
description: Binohash transaction digests for Bitcoin Script: smaller scripts, fewer opcodes and less honest grinding work at a fixed claimed security level.

components.name: Script bytes
components.note: The production locking script plus the largest unlocking script an honest spend can need. Both scripts in full, without their length prefixes; the rest of the two transactions is not counted.

components.name: Opcodes
components.note: The interpreter's operation count for the locking script on an honest spend: every opcode above OP_16 plus the number of keys of each executed OP_CHECKMULTISIG. Consensus allows 201.

components.name: Honest grinding work
components.note: Expected SHA-256 compressions for one honest spend under the reference grinder BH-WORK-1: the pinning puzzles, the rounds' searches and the retries when a round has no solution. The score counts work in units of 2^40 compressions.

fixed.name: Claimed security level
fixed.note: Collision resistance under the model BH-SEC-1, in sighash evaluations. Each track fixes a floor; an instance below it is refused.

tracks.name: standard
tracks.title: Standard: the paper's 5-byte configuration
tracks.description: At least the security level of the Binohash paper's standard configuration (5-byte pinning and round puzzles, two rounds of 120-choose-8), which this evaluator counts as 81.52 bits.

baseline.note: The construction of the Binohash paper (Appendix A pinning, Appendix B rounds) with its published parameters, built by this repository and counted by this evaluator.

tracks.name: high
tracks.title: High: the paper's 6-byte pinning configuration
tracks.description: At least the security level of the Binohash paper's higher-pinning configuration (6-byte pinning, 5-byte round puzzles, two rounds of 120-choose-8), which this evaluator counts as 88.41 bits.

baseline.note: The same construction with 6-byte pinning puzzles, as in the paper's 'Higher W1' row.

standard.summary: A Binohash instance is a legacy locking script whose honest spends carry a transaction digest: per round, a selection of t out of n script-embedded signatures that solves a signature-size puzzle, opened against one-time commitments. The security level is collision resistance under BH-SEC-1, the accounting of the Binohash paper (section 5.3) with puzzle work counted exactly by the evaluator. It is a claimed level under stated assumptions, not a proof.

build.note: Build knobs are the BINO_* entries of the manifest. The builders receive them as a dict; the track sets BINO_SPEC.

validation.seed: HMAC-SHA256 of the instance digest under the ledger key (spec/LEDGER.md)

acceptance.rule: Recorded if valid, at or above the track's security floor, and it is the first instance of its architecture, or beats that architecture's best score by the margin, or needs less work by the margin than every recorded instance that is no larger and uses no more opcodes.
